reviews.author: Tyler James
reviews.text: This is a great place to get all your mechanic needs meet... All the way from tires, brakes, and alignments, all the way to complete motor and trans swaps. The people are great and so a go job at a fair price!

reviews.author: Jennifer Sisk
reviews.text: Do not take your car for any work at Vic's tire - they damaged my rims while putting two new tires on and though the owner has not laid eyes on the damage he said he knows his shop didn't cause this. So I have damage only on the tires you put on and that is explained how? They do not care about their customers or their property.

reviews.author: Chad W
reviews.text: I started doing business with them when I purchased tires back a few years ago. The price for the work and the tires was extremely good. Later on I took my truck back the same year and had them change a headlight and the price for that was low. Fast forward to 2024 and now as I understand it the owner that used to run it doesn't really run it anymore as there were new owners as I understand it. Anyway I took my truck in to get brakes and for them to check a tire for an air leak. I also needed the passengers side headlight to be changed. I took the car in on a Monday at 2pm and even called before I drove over to see if they could do the work and have my truck to me the next day. They said they could so I drove over and left it. The next day I called and they said that they would have the car ready later that afternoon but would call. I asked if I need to check back and the gentleman said that he would call. I got no call. Next day I had to make arrangements to get over there to pick it up and when I called to check on my car they said that they had gotten the wrong brakes delivered(would have been nice to get a call the day before). I had asked what types of payments they took and they stated they took all forms but NEVER said that they charge a fee if you use a credit card. I asked about the total and noticed that they had charged for fixing my tire in the total. I had thought it would be under warranty since I purchased the tires there as I always get road side warranties with my tire purchases. Anyway with some going back and forth they removed the $30 charge as I was spending almost $700 with them for the repairs. Anyway when I got there the guy was rude by showing me that I didn't have a warranty on the tires and then DID NOT tell me as he was running my card that there would be a $25 service fee on top of the payment for the repairs. Whatever happened to "if you take care of a customer they will be loyal to you" or "the customer is always right". I will not be taking my car back there for anything! This is not a very good way to do business and the old gentleman that answers the phone was very rude and never apologized for taking longer than usual.

reviews.author: Heather Thomason
reviews.text: It was refreshing to finally find honest, reliable people to do repairs to my car. As a woman, a lot of mechanics take advantage of you. These guys were knowledgeable and very respectful. I highly recommend doing business with Vic's

reviews.author: Cathy Polk
reviews.text: I have been here on several occasions everyone is always fantastic. In the event that I have any questions it has always been explained to me, anything that I need or anything that I have fixed is explained in a way that I can understand. Decent pricing and great customer service and great work done as well! And yes it’s nice dealing with another woman when having any type of automotive work done because she doesn’t treat you like you’re a dumb woman... all the gentleman in the back are very polite and respectful.

reviews.author: russell jones
reviews.text: They have always done good work at a fair price. We have also bought tires multiple times for reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Alan Smith
reviews.text: This place is a great example of the benefits of locally owned businesses. They have a very friendly staff, reasonable prices and nice waiting area with a pool table. I brought in a wheel with a puncture in sidewall of the tire around lunch on a Thursday. They ordered the replacement tire and said it would be there by Friday morning. I was pleasantly surprised when I got a call at 3:30 Thursday afternoon to let me know it was done. Great experience all the way around. I would recommend highly and will definitely be back in the future.

reviews.author: Melinda Osburn
reviews.text: I will not be back at this business again. The first time I came to get a tire fixed, I thought maybe it was just a bad day and people were just grumpy. Today was my second chance for this business and I found the same. They acted as if they were annoyed with my presence and that I was a bother to them. I even asked if I needed to go somewhere else for service. I am not used to this attitude because I am a pretty likable, nice, genuine individual who tries to treat most people with respect. My husband owns a business so I am very aware that customer service and pleasant, helpful attitudes goes a long way in a successful business. I was told that they would need to drive the vehicle in and find the problem. I gave my keys and watched how he left my door open for an extended amount of time so my door and leather interior were soaked by the rain. The cashier seemed irritated and curt. Also, I thought having the hole plugged was overpriced. The tire was fixed and I could not wait to leave. Several positives were it was fast service and the young man checking the tire pressure was polite. When entering my car, the floor board mat was dripping with water and dirty fingerprints were on the light tan leather so............now I know why Perry’s is so busy. I will go there or find a dealership if I have anymore tire issues. I do not like to give bad reviews but I gave them a second chance and it was not successful either. I was very disappointed because I believe in supporting local businesses.

reviews.author: Michelle Dixon
reviews.text: Picked up a nail on the highway, was able to get to Vic's on our own...they did a plug + patch and had us on our way in under an hour on a busy Friday afternoon when we were trying to reach Atlanta for a play. Excellent work and very gratefully we found them.

reviews.author: Cletes Eats
reviews.text: They were very receptive! Told me over the phone they could get me right and within 5 minutes of checking in my truck was in the shop. Great work and quick! Thanks Vic's!

reviews.author: James Matthews
reviews.text: I called to get a quote for replacing my flat tire and a tire rotation. I was quoted a price of $103; which included taxes. I dropped off my car a few hours later and it was ready for pickup promptly thereafter. My bill was nearly $30 over the quoted price. I was told they sold out of the tire I was initially quoted on, but not notified beforehand. The tires were not rotated either and I had to get that addressed.

reviews.author: Tammy Wilson
reviews.text: Great Customer service!!!! Misty is and has always been helpful when it comes to helping me with my car. I don’t think I could ask for any better customer service! I highly recommend you to go to Vics for all of your car needs they will go above and beyond to making you happy!

reviews.author: Van Jones
reviews.text: THEY DROPPED MY TRUCK. I will never be back such a horrible experience. They use old wheel weights and left old ones on. I had to take to another shop to get tires balanced properly. They also installed my leveling kit wrong and i had to good back twice and tell them how to install. They still put it on wrong. Now I have to pay someone else to fix there problem. Everyone is incompetent. The secretary is so rude and thinks she knows everything. If you point something out wrong they did you will become the bad guy. Tried to blame me for there problems. Im sure no one there is even certified. I recommend everyone going to another tire shop to check there tires I can guarantee you have old weights on and are out of balance. This is coming from a former shop mechanic.

reviews.author: Anna Fallaw
reviews.text: Great service! I got a flat Wednesday after work. Tried other places to fix tire Black Friday all was closed. Luckily I called Vic’s they were open. Saved my day. Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Destiny Foster
reviews.text: Went here to get two rear tires. Employees were super friendly, and service was very quick when compared to most tire shops and the prices are very reasonable. I will definitely be going back when I need more tires.

reviews.author: Tyler Allen
reviews.text: Popped a tired on 85 and rolled up here with a spare; ended up swapping 4 tires in a hurry for a good price, in and out in probably less than half and hour. Staff was kind, helpful, informative, and helped me get back on the road to attend my own graduation.

reviews.author: Alicia Bigham
reviews.text: Loved the Friendly service here.. They go out of their way to make the customer happy. Affordable and amazing work. Will be recommending them often and will be back.

reviews.author: Shiraleigha Davidson
reviews.text: Older gentleman is rude. Didn’t even try to fix my car. And made it worse then what is was! If it’s NOT a tire I DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!!

reviews.author: Ricky Richardson
reviews.text: My car was serviced by Vic's Tire & Auto on last Wednesday. It was done right at the best price. I go here for all my vehicles needs.

reviews.author: Joel Gibbons
reviews.text: Great service. Fast service. Reasonable prices. Knowledgeable staff. I’m definitely going back when my vehicle needs anything.

reviews.author: Paula Steiger
reviews.text: I got a flat tire on my drive back to Virginia. I pulled into Vic’s and I got excellent, fast service at a reasonable price. I would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Joe Mama
reviews.text: They charged me $15 per tire to change my lawn mower tires that I brought in, so your standard lawn mower they'd charge you $60 even if you brought in your own tires to change. Seems a little steep to me folks!

reviews.author: Jesse Green
reviews.text: Had an appointment to get a front end alignment. I show up for my appointment and the lady up front tells me that they can’t do an alignment on my vehicle because of the age. She failed to mention anything about that when scheduling the appointment. They lost my business forever.

reviews.author: Robert Pringle
reviews.text: Very nice folks to deal with. Prices are reasonable, service is top notch. I love keeping the money local too.

reviews.author: Travis Kinley
reviews.text: Good prices great service. I ordered tires for my travel trailer one day had them installed the next.

reviews.author: Daniel E. Woodhead
reviews.text: I wasn't the customer but I have done business there before had an awesome experience, have not been back since they don't do wheel alignment on older vehicles aka 1994 , lady told 2000 an above, still a good place fair price that all I can say about that..

reviews.author: Linda Bolin
reviews.text: Great customer service,in about an hour,,they had found that a problem with my front end,they called,,fixed ,and one thing i did learn,,the next day,was freezing,and one tire looked slack,,i went to get air,,and the service station said it does that sometimes when the weather gets to cold,no more problems,very good price ,i shopped around and they had the best price,i will be getting my tires from them,This is the second set i have purchased,Thanks..Linda.

reviews.author: NATALIE MONTGOMERY
reviews.text: No issues everything I asked was check verified and fixed. Nice customer service. She went beyond what I needed.

reviews.author: Jessica Pall
reviews.text: Great service, super friendly & efficient . I highly recommend them to anyone in Gaffney. They have kept my 350,000 van running to the end

reviews.author: Roxanne Reynolds
reviews.text: I recently had to buy a new tire for my SUV. They ordered the tire which was delivered the next day and had me on the road in no time. They really are a pleasure to do business with.

reviews.author: Drew Wheeler Sr
reviews.text: Don't go anywhere else!.. great service and they stand behind there work and tire's..always a great experience!..fair price

reviews.author: marcus moore
reviews.text: Had them check a tire for leaking air, didn't find anything but didn't charge anything for checking it.

reviews.author: Dan Rowlette
reviews.text: Not helpful refuses to help ended up stranded.... girl at the front desk was more interested in her phone.
